AIFF Election Nomination Questioned, President Responds

A former Karnataka State Football Association (KSFA) official, MP Swamy, has questioned the nomination of Kalyan Chaubey for the All India Football Federation (AIFF) elections. In response, Kalyan Chaubey, the AIFF president, has hit back at critics and promised a four-year report.
